channel.title: Distribute Press Releases
channel.description: Press releases published and syndicated by Distribute Press Releases. Every item is labeled as a paid or affiliated placement, and publication is not verification.

item.title: My AI Agent Army Opens an AI Agent Factory and Publishes the Real Output of 17 Built-and-Tested Agents
item.dc:creator: My AI Agent Army
item.description: My AI Agent Army opens an AI agent factory for businesses and publishes real reports and drafts from 17 agents it has already built and tested.

item.title: allofus.one Puts Members in Control of Their Social Network: Their Feed, Their Ads Setting and Their Data
item.dc:creator: allofus.one
item.description: allofus.one, the free Denver-built social network, is built around member control: a chronological feed, an ads on-off setting and data you can take with you.

item.title: NexGen Lead Groups Opens Free Referral Groups in Denver Metro, Colorado Springs and Fort Collins and Is Now Accepting New Members
item.dc:creator: NexGen Lead Groups
item.description: NexGen Lead Groups is accepting members for free referral groups in Denver Metro, Colorado Springs and Fort Collins: one seat per trade, no dues.

item.title: Showers4Less Expands Its Online Shower Catalog Past 400 Products and Opens Applications for Dealers and Installers
item.dc:creator: Showers4Less
item.description: Showers4Less refreshed its online catalog to more than 400 shower products, including ANZZI, and is now taking applications from dealers and installers.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Opens Total Market Domination, Selling One Exclusive Industry Slot Per State on Its Business Directory Network
item.dc:creator: Eye To Ad Media
item.description: One business per industry per state gets the pop-up and large banner placements on USABusinessSearch.com, plus COBusinessList.com for Colorado slots.

item.title: Elevation Health Lays Out Three Care Paths for Metabolic Health, With Online Access Around the Clock
item.dc:creator: Elevation Health
item.description: Denver telehealth provider Elevation Health names its three care paths and explains how licensed providers handle prescriptions. Online 24/7.

item.title: allofus.one Opens Its Free Social Platform in Beta: One Account for a Chronological Feed, 3D Worlds and VR in the Browser
item.dc:creator: allofus.one
item.description: allofus.one opens its free beta: one account for a chronological feed, a 3D world in the browser and VR on Quest, plus free tools.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Confirms Ella’s Bubbles Dealership, Putting Four Walk-In Tub Brands Under One BBB-Accredited Roof
item.dc:creator: Aging Safely Baths
item.description: Aging Safely Baths is an Ella's Bubbles dealer, so families can compare Ella's Bubbles, Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath and Meditub tubs with one BBB-accredited company.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Opens a Press Release Network That Routes Each Release to the Local Sites It Fits
item.dc:creator: Eye To Ad Media
item.description: Every release is now republished on a news site and routed by a public filter to the Colorado and Hawaii sites it fits, with a receipt.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Begins Custom-Coding AI Agents for Small Businesses, Starting With Lead Response
item.dc:creator: Eye To Ad Media
item.description: Denver-based Eye To Ad Media now custom-codes AI agents for small businesses, starting with lead response, with a person approving every action.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Publishes a Six-Point Fit Check for Families Shopping for a Walk-In Tub
item.dc:creator: Aging Safely Baths
item.description: Six measurements to take before requesting a walk-in tub quote, from doorway width to water heater capacity, published by the accessible bathing supplier.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Explains Curbed vs. Barrier-Free Showers for Households Replacing a Bathtub
item.dc:creator: Aging Safely Baths
item.description: When a low curb is enough and when a true zero-threshold shower is worth the floor work, from a Bestbath dealer that has installed both since 2012.
